# Accessor: normalized

## Get Signature

```ts
get normalized(): [number, number, number, number];
```

Normalized *(0-1)* RGBA tuple.

Useful for passing color data to WebGL shaders.

### Returns

\[`number`, `number`, `number`, `number`\]

A [r, g, b, a] tuple where each component is between 0.0 and 1.0.
